tools.name: list_segments
tools.description: List every LIVE comparison segment on nakus.sk with its unit metric (€/kg, €/kus, €/pranie, €/ml, €/m…). Use FIRST when the user asks what categories NaKus covers, which metric a category uses, or before searching if you are unsure whether a product type is in scope. Does NOT return prices, Cite slu

tools.name: search_cite_answers
tools.description: Search Slovak Cite Q&A slugs on nakus.sk (diapers, laundry, pet food, coffee…). Use when you do not know the exact answer slug or EAN. If you do not know whether the category exists at all, call list_segments first. Returns candidate slugs only — does NOT return the Cite body, live €/unit, or shop l

tools.name: get_cite_answer
tools.description: Read ONE Cite Q&A by exact answer slug: question, answer_sentence, metric, EAN, ranked shop offers[], buy_url. Works even when live offers are empty (found=false) — unlike get_unit_price, which errors without offers. Use AFTER search_cite_answers when you need the Cite body / full offer table / cita

tools.name: get_unit_price
tools.description: Return the current landed unit price (€/piece, €/kg, €/wash, €/m…) for ONE product Cite, plus buy_url (always nakus.sk/out/?src=ai — never raw merchant/Heureka), ranked offers[], handoff_url, price_card_url. Use when the user asks how much X costs per unit / cheapest shop, and you already have answe

tools.name: compare_unit_prices
tools.description: Compare landed €/unit for 2–4 Cite products side-by-side and return cheapest_answer. Use when the user asks which of several known products is cheaper per unit (same or different brands). Pass exact answer slugs and/or EANs — discover slugs via search_cite_answers first. Does NOT replace get_unit_pr

tools.name: get_price_card
tools.description: Return only the 1200×630 PNG price-card URL for a Cite answer (multimodal / Gemini / AI Mode / social). Use when the agent needs an image, not JSON price fields. Requires exact answer slug — discover via search_cite_answers or get_cite_answer first. Does not replace get_unit_price / get_cite_answer

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_unit_price" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Return the current landed unit price (€/piece, €/kg, €/wash, €/m…) for ONE product Cite, plus buy_url (always nakus.sk/out/?src=ai — never raw merchant/Heureka)…
